author: Crimson_Aught
body:
Hello everyone!  This is my first map for AV.  I tried to make it sweet :D So, main platforms look like pies. Each team has three iron souffle, enchantment table and chance to take diamond lollipops on middle cakes! ...and maybe they gonna win.
Edited: totally rebuilt mid and invert side islands, remove front monument, covered edges with quartz slabs.
I hope, you like it. Or criticism is wellcome :D

Map name: Berry Mix
Creator: Crimson_Aught
Gamemode: Destroy the Monument (DTM)
Teams: Raspberries(20) vs Blueberries(20)
Monuments: Right, Left
Size: 165 blocks x 120 blocks
Download map and YML file: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/usy79jq2b8qwemz/AAAdLLaJfOC6SC64HvY7-FODa?dl=0
Pictures v.3.1 and 3.0:http://imgur.com/a/tcvJV ; http://imgur.com/a/UhzKj
Pictures v.2, v.1:http://imgur.com/a/NdeQe ; http://imgur.com/a/97cxI

replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
First off, this map isn't all that bad, but I feel as though it would easily stalemate
seeing as there are barely any islands to compensate for the distance and shape of
the outer rim, in addition to this, the front monument would be very hard to rush seeing as it is located just in front of spawn. The map is also somewhat flat, it would help to have a blockade at the edges for
protection from bowfire. he middle island and map in general should also have good
space for PVP, I feel as people are going to be knocked off very easily. The map also seems relatively small, especially for a DTM - 50v50


Overall it's not all that bad, it just needs some tweaks that aren't overly major and the map should be just fine :P

Great job thus far.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Berry Mix, has been denied from testing for the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you remove most of the void by expanding the map more. I also suggest that you move the monuments somewhere else as the location of those monuments are too close to spawn and too close together.


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You May resubmit your map once edited
